# STD-TEC-EKS-003: Helm

**Standards Metadata**

```yaml
standard_id: 'STD-TEC-EKS-003'
standard_name: 'Helm Chart Development'
standard_type: 'technology'
category: 'technology'
version: '1.0.0'
status: 'active'
compliance_level: 'mandatory'
tags: ['technology', 'eks', 'kubernetes', 'helm', 'mandatory']
```

---

> Defines standards for Helm chart development and deployment within enterprise Amazon EKS environments. Ensures consistent, maintainable, and secure application deployments using Helm with proper chart structure, templating practices, and deployment procedures.

---
page_texts.3:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#10-purpose]

## 1.0 Purpose

This standard establishes requirements for Helm chart development and deployment to ensure consistent, maintainable, and secure application deployments using Helm.
page_texts.5:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#21-standard-chart-directory-layout]

### 2.1 Standard Chart Directory Layout

All Helm charts must follow this standardized structure:

```text
chart-name/
├── Chart.yaml               # Chart metadata
├── values.yaml              # Default configuration values
├── values-dev.yaml          # Development environment values
├── values-staging.yaml      # Staging environment values
├── values-prod.yaml         # Production environment values
├── README.md                # Chart documentation
├── .helmignore              # Files to ignore during packaging
├── charts/                  # Chart dependencies (if any)
├── templates/               # Kubernetes manifest templates
│   ├── NOTES.txt            # Post-installation notes
│   ├── _helpers.tpl         # Template helpers
│   ├── configmap.yaml       # Configuration maps
│   ├── deployment.yaml      # Deployment manifest
│   ├── service.yaml         # Service manifest
│   ├── ingress.yaml         # Ingress manifest
│   ├── serviceaccount.yaml  # Service account
│   ├── rbac.yaml            # RBAC resources
│   ├── secrets.yaml         # Secret resources
│   └── tests/               # Helm test definitions
│       └── test-*.yaml
└── crds/                    # Custom Resource Definitions (if needed)
```
page_texts.6:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#22-chartyaml-requirements]

### 2.2 Chart.yaml Requirements

All charts must include comprehensive metadata:

```yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: fusion-auth-api
description: Fusion Authentication API microservice
type: application
version: 1.0.0
appVersion: '1.0.0'
home: https://github.com/gainwell-technologies/fusion-idaas
sources:
    - https://github.com/gainwell-technologies/fusion-idaas
maintainers:
    - name: Gainwell Technologies
      email: fusion-team@gainwelltechnologies.com
keywords:
    - fusion
    - authentication
    - api
    - microservice
annotations:
    category: Security
    licenses: Proprietary
dependencies: []
```
page_texts.8:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#31-naming-conventions]

### 3.1 Naming Conventions

**Chart Names**:

- Use lowercase with hyphens: `fusion-auth-api`, `fusion-admin-api`
- Follow pattern: `fusion-{service-name}-api`
- Must match the application/service name

**Template Names**:

- Use descriptive names: `deployment.yaml`, `service.yaml`, `configmap.yaml`
- Group related resources: `rbac.yaml` for all RBAC resources
- Use prefixes for variations: `service-headless.yaml`, `configmap-env.yaml`

**Resource Names**:

- Use chart name as base: `{{ include "fusion-auth-api.fullname" . }}`
- Add component suffix: `{{ include "fusion-auth-api.fullname" . }}-config`
- Maintain consistency across all resources
page_texts.11:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#41-valuesyaml-structure]

### 4.1 Values.yaml Structure

Organize values hierarchically and provide sensible defaults:

```yaml
# Global configuration
global:
    imageRegistry: ''
    imagePullSecrets: []
    storageClass: ''

# Application configuration
app:
    name: fusion-auth-api
    version: '1.0.0'
    environment: development

# Image configuration
image:
    registry: 'your-registry.amazonaws.com'
    repository: 'fusion/auth-api'
    tag: '{{ .Chart.AppVersion }}'
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

# Service configuration
service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 8000
    targetPort: 8000
    annotations: {}

# Ingress configuration
ingress:
    enabled: false
    className: 'alb'
    annotations:
        kubernetes.io/ingress.class: alb
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internal
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/target-type: ip
    hosts:
        - host: auth-api.fusion.gainwell.com
          paths:
              - path: /
                pathType: Prefix
    tls: []

# Resource configuration
resources:
    limits:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 1Gi
    requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 512Mi

# Autoscaling configuration
autoscaling:
    enabled: true
    minReplicas: 2
    maxReplicas: 10
    targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 70
    targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80

# Security configuration
podSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 1000
    fsGroup: 1000

securityContext:
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    capabilities:
        drop:
            - ALL

# Monitoring configuration
monitoring:
    enabled: true
    serviceMonitor:
        enabled: true
        interval: 30s
        path: /metrics

# Configuration and secrets
config:
    database:
        host: ''
        port: 5432
        name: 'fusion_auth'
    redis:
        host: ''
        port: 6379
    logging:
        level: 'INFO'
        format: 'json'

secrets:
    database:
        username: ''
        password: ''
    redis:
        password: ''
    jwt:
        secret: ''
```
page_texts.12:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#42-environment-specific-values]

### 4.2 Environment-Specific Values

**Development (values-dev.yaml)**:

```yaml
replicaCount: 1
resources:
    limits:
        cpu: 200m
        memory: 512Mi
    requests:
        cpu: 50m
        memory: 256Mi
config:
    logging:
        level: 'DEBUG'
```

**Production (values-prod.yaml)**:

```yaml
replicaCount: 3
resources:
    limits:
        cpu: 1000m
        memory: 2Gi
    requests:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 1Gi
autoscaling:
    enabled: true
    minReplicas: 3
    maxReplicas: 20
```
page_texts.18:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#61-secret-management]

### 6.1 Secret Management

**Use External Secret Management**:

```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: SecretStore
metadata:
  name: {{ include "fusion-auth-api.fullname" . }}-secret-store
spec:
  provider:
    aws:
      service: SecretsManager
      region: us-east-1
      auth:
        serviceAccount:
          name: {{ include "fusion-auth-api.serviceAccountName" . }}
```

**Reference Secrets in Deployments**:

```yaml
env:
  - name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: {{ include "fusion-auth-api.fullname" . }}-secrets
        key: database-password
```
page_texts.19:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#62-security-context]

### 6.2 Security Context

Always define security contexts:

```yaml
spec:
    template:
        spec:
            securityContext: { { - toYaml .Values.podSecurityContext | nindent 8 } }
            containers:
                - name: { { .Chart.Name } }
                  securityContext: { { - toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 12 } }
```
page_texts.20:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#63-network-policies]

### 6.3 Network Policies

Include network policy templates:

```yaml
{{- if .Values.networkPolicy.enabled }}
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: {{ include "fusion-auth-api.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "fusion-auth-api.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "fusion-auth-api.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/name: fusion-gateway
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: {{ .Values.service.targetPort }}
{{- end }}
```
page_texts.22:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#71-release-management]

### 7.1 Release Management

**Deployment Commands**:

```bash
# Development deployment
helm upgrade --install fusion-auth-api ./charts/fusion-auth-api \
  --namespace fusion-dev \
  --values ./charts/fusion-auth-api/values-dev.yaml \
  --create-namespace

# Production deployment
helm upgrade --install fusion-auth-api ./charts/fusion-auth-api \
  --namespace fusion-prod \
  --values ./charts/fusion-auth-api/values-prod.yaml \
  --create-namespace \
  --wait \
  --timeout 600s
```

**Pre-deployment Validation**:

```bash
# Lint chart
helm lint ./charts/fusion-auth-api

# Template validation
helm template fusion-auth-api ./charts/fusion-auth-api \
  --values ./charts/fusion-auth-api/values-prod.yaml

# Dry-run deployment
helm upgrade --install fusion-auth-api ./charts/fusion-auth-api \
  --namespace fusion-prod \
  --values ./charts/fusion-auth-api/values-prod.yaml \
  --dry-run
```
page_texts.23:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#72-rolling-updates]

### 7.2 Rolling Updates

Configure rolling update strategy:

```yaml
spec:
    strategy:
        type: RollingUpdate
        rollingUpdate:
            maxUnavailable: 25%
            maxSurge: 25%
```
page_texts.24:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#73-health-checks]

### 7.3 Health Checks

Include comprehensive health checks:

```yaml
livenessProbe:
    httpGet:
        path: /health/live
        port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 30
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 5
    failureThreshold: 3

readinessProbe:
    httpGet:
        path: /health/ready
        port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 5
    periodSeconds: 5
    timeoutSeconds: 3
    failureThreshold: 3
```
page_texts.26:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#81-helm-tests]

### 8.1 Helm Tests

Create test pods in `templates/tests/`:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: "{{ include "fusion-auth-api.fullname" . }}-test"
  labels:
    {{- include "fusion-auth-api.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": test
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  containers:
    - name: wget
      image: busybox
      command: ['wget']
      args: ['{{ include "fusion-auth-api.fullname" . }}:{{ .Values.service.port }}/health']
```

**Run Tests**:

```bash
helm test fusion-auth-api --namespace fusion-dev
```
page_texts.27:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#82-chart-validation]

### 8.2 Chart Validation

**Required Validations**:

- Helm lint passes without errors
- Template rendering produces valid YAML
- Security scanning passes
- Resource limits are defined
- Health checks are configured
page_texts.29:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#91-chart-versioning]

### 9.1 Chart Versioning

Follow semantic versioning:

- **MAJOR**: Breaking changes to chart API
- **MINOR**: New features, backward compatible
- **PATCH**: Bug fixes, backward compatible
page_texts.30:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#92-chart-packaging]

### 9.2 Chart Packaging

**Package Chart**:

```bash
helm package ./charts/fusion-auth-api --destination ./dist/
```

**Push to Repository**:

```bash
helm repo add fusion-charts s3://fusion-helm-charts/
helm push fusion-auth-api-1.0.0.tgz fusion-charts
```
page_texts.31:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-003-helm.md#93-chart-documentation]

### 9.3 Chart Documentation

**Required Documentation**:

- README.md with installation instructions
- VALUES.md with all configuration options
- CHANGELOG.md with version history
- Security considerations
